verdict.rationale: The docs show LM Studio runs a range of local LLMs (gpt-oss, Llama, Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi) through llama.cpp and Apple MLX, with Hugging Face search and download and an embeddings endpoint. Community users confirm Hugging Face models generally download and work, and that MLX is supported, though one notes some Hugging Face models aren't listed. missing for 10: explicit evidence of support for hundreds of architectures, documented multi-modal/vision model support, explicit MoE support (only implied by model names), and an architecture compatibility list.
